tools.name: signup_free
tools.description:
Start a 30-day trial. No credit card required. Then $1 per account/month.
        Includes 3 pixels and 500 new contacts per UTC calendar month, with no extra charges.

        Returns account_id and signup_token. A confirmation email is sent to the
        email address. Open the link in that email

tools.name: confirm_signup
tools.description:
Confirm the email address from the link in the signup email.

        Copy the token value from the confirmation URL (?token=...) and pass it
        here. This activates the confirmed trial account.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description:
Get your API key after the email is confirmed.

        Requires the account_id and signup_token from trial registration.
        Returns a private API key once. Keep the key confidential.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description:
Which account this connection's API key belongs to.

        status is the account after email confirmation and checkout.
        plan is free during the 30-day trial, paid after the subscription, or unlimited for internal accounts. key_prefix is the start of the key, not the key.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description:
Whether this account can use pixels and whether a tag is installed.

        setup_complete is true once at least one pixel's tag has been seen on
        its site. good_standing is the account, not the tag.

tools.name: list_pixels
tools.description: Pixels on this account. Each item has pixel_id, domain, and install_status.

tools.name: create_pixel
tools.description:
Create a pixel for a domain and return the HTML snippet to paste on that site.

        Does not create an API key. The account must already be active.
        install_status starts as not_checked until check_install runs.

tools.name: get_pixel
tools.description: One pixel, including the HTML snippet to paste on its site.

tools.name: check_install
tools.description:
Fetch the pixel's homepage and store whether the tag is there.

        install_status becomes installed or not_installed. check_error says
        why a check could not decide. Evaluator accounts fetch only the fixed
        https://staging.allsourcedata.io/evaluation-test/ page and reject redirect

tools.name: configure_consent
tools.description:
Turn on and set up the privacy bar for a pixel.

        controller_name: the business that owns the site (shown in the bar).
        purposes: what the bar asks for. Choose from analytics, resolution,
        newsletter, email_sharing, phone_sharing, partner_email, partner_calls,
        partner_sm

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description:
Hosted privacy and data-use policy HTML for a pixel.

        A pixel with consent turned off has no policy yet.

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description:
Resolved contacts for one pixel.

        Pass on as a UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD), or after as the high_water from the
        previous pull. Pass one of them. after 0 starts at the first stored contact.
        Use high_water as the next cursor. New contacts can arrive between reads.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: signup_free, create_api_key, get_pixel, get_policy · Private data: signup_free, confirm_signup, create_api_key, whoami, create_pixel, get_contacts · Public sink: signup_free, confirm_signup, create_api_key, whoami, configure_consent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: signup_free, create_api_key, get_pixel, get_policy · Private data: signup_free, confirm_signup, create_api_key, whoami, create_pixel, get_contacts · Public sink: signup_free, confirm_signup, create_api_key, whoami, configure_consent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
